title: CfpcTensorContract
description: K'UHUL tensor execution contract. @kind must be khanary.tensor.contract.v1. Declares the tensor representation, operator, accumulator, and phase-gated execution lifecycle. The five routing heads (v_pi, domain_relation, pi_radius, intent, cfpc_phase) populate @routing at inference time; the contract is the authority layer that validates whether execution is authorized. Pattern Induction Guard: promote_generated_facts MUST be false — any other value is a schema violation.

id.description: Unique contract identifier used for cycle detection and result attribution.

intent.description: Optional semantic intent of this contract (metadata for routing).

phase_entry.description: Phase at which the contract opens. Usually Pop (receive) or Wo (bind). Must precede authorization_phase.

@tensor.description: Input tensor representation constraints. These are requirements, not values.

shape.description: Required shape. Integer means fixed; string means symbolic/variable.

@operator.description: Operator contract. Declares what transformation runs and what output it must produce.

name.description: MAP: Tensor→Tensor element-wise. FILTER: Tensor→Tensor/Selection. FOLD: Accumulator×Value→Accumulator (stateful sequence). REDUCE: Tensor→Result along axes (may use a fold internally). STACK: N×rank-k→rank-(k+1) (rank-increasing; assembles slices along a new leading axis). FOLD and REDUCE are distinct: FOLD carries accumulator state through a sequence; REDUCE combines values into a result.

axis.description: Axis or axes for REDUCE. Null means reduce all axes. Not required for MAP, FILTER, FOLD.

output_shape.description: Required output shape after the operator runs. Verified at Ch'en before Xul close.

accumulator_shape.description: Shape of the accumulator for FOLD (accumulator state) and REDUCE (intermediate state). Must match output_shape for FOLD.

identity.description: Accumulator identity element. 'zeros' for addition, 'ones' for multiplication, 'neg_inf' for max, 'pos_inf' for min. 'none' means caller supplies initial state.

@lifecycle.description: Phase-gated execution steps. Each phase key lists the steps that run in that phase. Steps are verified in order; any failure stops progression and opens a gap.

Yax.description: Prepare candidate transformations and initialize accumulator.

Sek.description: Dispatch authorized operation. require_authorization must appear here if authorization is needed.

Ch'en.description: Verify result and invariants (rank, shape, dtype, output contract).

Xul.description: Close verified accumulator and emit result.

@routing.description: Routing head outputs. Populated at inference time by VPiRouter.route_program(). Not required at schema definition time — absent means unconstrained. When present, dispatch validates that the runtime routing program satisfies these constraints.

dominant_field.description: Required semantic field from intent_head (e.g. ⟁KUHUL, ⟁COMBUSTION). 'any' means unconstrained.

dominant_operator.description: Required XCFE operator from domain_relation_head. Maps to @operator.name: map→MAP/FILTER, accumulate→FOLD, reduce→REDUCE, stack→STACK.

dominant_phase.description: Required K'UHUL phase from cfpc_phase_head. Must be compatible with @lifecycle step availability.

depth_norm_min.description: Minimum normalized depth from pi_radius_head. Contracts that require deep traversal can gate on depth_norm >= threshold.

max_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth in the K'UHUL domain hierarchy. Corresponds to pi_radius_head depth_norm bound.

allow_partial_shape.description: If true, symbolic shape dimensions are permitted at dispatch. If false, all dimensions must be resolved to integers before Sek.

promote_generated_facts.description: Pattern Induction Guard — MUST be false. Grammar-level invariant, not a runtime policy. No parser may accept true.
